claims.text: Al0.2Co1.5CrFeNi1.5Ti0.3 is a dual-nanoprecipitation HEA system.
TEM can help elucidate the oxidation behavior of Al0.2Co1.5CrFeNi1.5Ti0.3 by characterizing nanoprecipitates and associated mechanistic changes.
APT can help elucidate the oxidation behavior of Al0.2Co1.5CrFeNi1.5Ti0.3 by measuring elemental redistribution associated with nanoprecipitates.
High-temperature oxidation is the proposed intervention.
Nanoprecipitates mediate the oxidation behavior of the alloy.
Elemental redistribution is part of the proposed oxidation mechanism.
Oxidation reactions are part of the proposed mechanism.
Studying nanoprecipitates and elemental redistribution will improve understanding of oxidation behavior and its effects on material properties.
Cast and wrought counterparts of the HEA are the proposed baseline.
The relevant application boundary includes gas turbines, power plants, and aerospace components.
The exact oxidation-degradation and elemental-redistribution mechanisms in this HEA are not well understood.
Controlled oxidation experiments combined with TEM and APT can test the hypothesis by measuring oxidation kinetics, elemental distribution, and microstructural evolution.
